# Release Notes

## v5.2.0

[Commits](https://github.com/kpdecker/jsdiff/compare/v5.1.0...master)

- [#411](https://github.com/kpdecker/jsdiff/pull/411) Big performance improvement. Previously an O(n) array-copying operation inside the innermost loop of jsdiff's base diffing code increased the overall worst-case time complexity of computing a diff from O(n²) to O(n³). This is now fixed, bringing the worst-case time complexity down to what it theoretically should be for a Myers diff implementatio
